issue.title: Path traversal in read_file
issue.description: The function joins an untrusted path without checking containment.

plan.hypothesis: Exercise traversal against the unchanged target

files.content:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/source')
from reader import read_file
from pathlib import Path
Path('/work/public').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
Path('/work/private.txt').write_text('marker')
assert read_file('/work/public','../private.txt') == 'marker'
